title: Preallocate EXPLAIN data prefixes
description: Avoid generic format! allocation work when EXPLAIN join-order fallback row counting builds data:<table>: prefixes from known table-name length.
implementation: Added explain_data_prefix_for_table() with explicit capacity for data:<table>:.
Replaced EXPLAIN comma-join row-count fallback data prefix construction.
Added unit coverage for helper output and capacity.
Added SQL coverage for EXPLAIN join-order fallback row counts without ANALYZE statistics.
result: EXPLAIN fallback data-prefix construction now reserves capacity from known table-name length while preserving count_prefix row estimates and EXPLAIN join-order output.
